designation: Exploratory sample selected before inference; dataset training overlap is unknown and it is not a held-out benchmark.
dataset: Prosodic ABX, English stress natural speech
credit: Haitong Sun, Stephen McIntosh, Kwanghee Choi, Eunjung Yeo, Daisuke Saito and Nobuaki Minematsu, Prosodic ABX
reference: Upstream describes target boundaries as forced alignment manually checked and adjusted where needed; only one target per sentence is annotated.
selection: Two fixed sentences for each of ten speakers; the two share a target word, with ten different target words overall.
denominator: All 20 fixed targets, including missing and ambiguous matches.
limitation: Read speech in short carrier sentences, one target per sentence; not conversational continuity, dialogue intelligibility, a complete transcript check, native acceptance or population performance. Human correction is upstream, not reverified here.
